entries.title: About ANON, whats next?
entries.description: ANON, a game I made to compete with major PCVR titles like Boneworks and Blood Trail, the development has sadly stopped. This has came from the fact that it costs too much money, and that spending time developing something like this would take years if not decades as an indie dev. This doesn't mean the game is called off, I will most likely start working on it again in 2027. If you are reading this past 2027 check out the link to see if I actually made it, or if it has began development.
